title: Virasoro Symmetry in Neural Network Field Theories
abstract: arXiv:2512.24420v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We construct the Virasoro algebra from a neural free-field architecture. A logarithmic momentum law and a smooth spectral window give the weight-one current kernel, whose radial-ordering discontinuity fixes the oscillator pairing. The limiting neural current correlations agree with the Fock vacuum correlations. Their Sugawara stress tensor gives the Virasoro algebra with central charge one, and charged vertex insertions identify its highest-weight sectors. Bounds on regulator and feature errors control finite-mode approximations to this representation. At finite width, an explicit adjoint-compatible projection defines an auxiliary Fock readout when its Hermitian mixed block is positive. Cauchy features extend the construction to fermionic and supersymmetric sectors, including a Clifford zero mode in the Ramond representation, while first-order stress tensors give fermionic and bosonic ghost systems. translated_title: 神经网络场论中的Virasoro对称性
translated_abstract: 我们从神经自由场架构中构造出Virasoro代数。一个对数动量律和一个光滑谱窗口给出了权重为一的流核，其径向排序的不连续性确定了振荡器配对。极限下的神经流关联与Fock真空关联一致。其Sugawara应力张量给出中心荷为一的Virasoro代数，带荷顶点插入识别出其最高权扇区。对调节器误差与特征误差的界控制了该表示的有限模式近似。在有限宽度下，一个显式的伴随相容投影在其厄米混合块为正时定义了一个辅助Fock读出。柯西（Cauchy）特征将该构造推广至费米子与超对称扇区，包括Ramond表示中的Clifford零模，而一阶应力张量给出费米子与玻色子幽灵系统。共享的反射特征……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文从神经自由场架构出发严格构造出中心荷为一的Virasoro代数，证明极限神经流关联与Fock真空关联一致，并将该构造推广至费米子与超对称扇区。
en_tdlr: This paper rigorously constructs the Virasoro algebra with central charge one from a neural free-field architecture, showing that limiting neural current correlations coincide with Fock vacuum correlations and extending the construction to fermionic and supersymmetric sectors.
